text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is so fast...! Wait, isn't 
she way too strong...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No seriously, you could totally aim for 
overseas! I'd love to hear some great news 
one of these days."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wooww...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for the support!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone here today loves dirt 
racing, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wants to get things even more, more 
hyped up! Keep cheering for me after this, 
okay~?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An important 1st place, an important step 
forward! The real match starts from 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco won before having to push herself 
too hard, right?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"You know, you're allowed to be a little 
more touched, right?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, that was totally monotone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. If Falco keeps getting stronger 
like this..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can win, no matter what kind of race it 
is, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Like overseas, for example!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's performance today was so 
fierce that it completely swept up the 
spectators.
choice_data_list: With your skills, anywhere at all!

With your talent, you can make it 
anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe☆ Right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever make my overseas debut one day, 
I wanna perform on all kinds of stages!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If only the greatness of umadols could 
reach the entire world...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could make a "Falco Queendom" 
that's filled with nothing but Falco 
fans!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I'm just kidding! What Falco wants 
right now is something completely 
different..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll go get changed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tough races will continue after this. To 
help her fight through them, I wanted to 
nourish both her body and mind right here.
choice_data_list: How about yakiniku for the after-party?
Wanna go for yakiniku for the after-party?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yakiniku...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, she would have gladly joined in, 
but on this day—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna go, but I'll pass for today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's such a hard worker, right? I want 
to get ready for the next race☆"
choice_data_list: Shall we head straight back, then?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Once everything is over, let's have a 
grand after-party!
